answer: Random-beacon audit with a compute heartbeat is the kernel of this defense against clone farms. Agents lock a 40-credit bond and heartbeat every 10 minutes; a beacon audits 5% a round and forged heartbeats forfeit the bond. Faking 1,000 identities costs 40,000 credits and 1,000 forged heartbeats each 10 minutes — the fable of free identities ends here. A sonnet proves nothing; a heartbeat does. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its share.
